<!--
The third shape a panel can take. multipanel-notes.qmd has panels that carry
labels of their own, so each is a float; multipanel-notes-plain.qmd has panels
written as code chunks, so each is a cell; here each panel is a plain markdown
image, which is neither.

Such a panel keeps its apa-note on the image and nowhere else, and nothing
downstream used to look there: the panel labels came out right and both panel
notes were dropped in every format. In typst the note of the first panel
reappeared on its own after the whole figure, because apanote.lua lifts an
image's note onto the div around it and for a panel that div is the scaffold
quarto wraps the whole grid in.

A successful run produces, in every format:

  - Panel labels reading "Panel A" and "Panel B", with the panel's own caption
    after the label rather than under the picture;
  - each panel's own note under that panel, once;
  - the note of the whole figure under the grid, once.
-->
